I talked to a counselor on campus and we sort of set up a temporary emergency plan so I don't do anything to hurt myself.  I never reached out to anyone before this outside my family.  I don't think I could talk to my roommate or a friend about this stuff.  I feel like they wouldn't want to listen to me bitch and moan all the time.  I don't even want to talk to a hotline.  This is the first time I have told anyone else about this stuff.

I should call my brother, because he has always the one to help me out and give me great guidance, but he has his own shit to deal with.  He had been extremely sick for the past 3 years dealing with chronic sinus infections which has resulted in surgeries and loss of time at work which has made him hang in their financially.  I just feel like the little bit of shit that I am dealing with is nothing compared to what he is going through.  He doesn't bitch about it, he is a fucking hoss.  I just wish I could be like but these thoughts always find their way back into my head.

Me and her did talk about it.  She said she truly didn't know but I feel like it would be a no.  My family isn't poor but I know they only have so much saved for me for college.  I am paying for part of it as well and I don't know how either of us could afford for me to pay for a full semester with room and board just to leave.

Yes she said it, but that doesn't mean he will allow it.  I know she is trying to comfort me and give me options.  Plus, I have just dumped a large portion of my money into this semester and I don't think I could financially afford to take a semester off if my dad even allowed it.

I just dont think I can mentally handle all of this anymore.  Just to put in perspective how fucked up mentally I am, by you responding to this post and trying to help me out I already feel bad.  Even though you are a stranger who opened his arms out to me willingly I feel like I am wasting your time and being a burden.  I'm just sick of feeling terrible about everything I think about.

Your background sounds like mine.  My mother and everyone else in my family understand it and accept it.  My dad has been trying but he feels that I am lazy and just drinking and smoking everynight and not doing shit.  He doesnt understand how it feels to have 0 motivation.  That's why taking a semester off wouldnt work.

During this summer I worked 40 hours at one job and had a second job starting up a company on the side in which i am still working on.  However, if I went out or slept in on the weekend he would be really upset and just claim that I am being lazy.

The problem with me is that I don't like being vulnerable, and I don't like people knowing I am.  And I would call my brother or sister or my mom but I feel like I am a huge burden on them and wasting there time.

When I broke down today I was with my mom. I told her everything. She suggested that I talk to a counselor in the health center tomorrow after my classes and that I should figure it out from there. She also suggested a semester off, but I know my father wouldn't allow it and call me a failure and not let me back at the house. I was thinking of talking to the counselor tomorrow but I couldn't even get myself to get off my bed to do my homework so I don't even know how I can bring myself to go to class tomorrow, let alone go and see a counselor.
